name: Browser navigate
description: Navigates the visible in-app browser panel (Workbench Browser tab) to an absolute http(s) URL, in the same webview the user is watching.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 把用户眼前可见的内嵌浏览器（工作台「浏览器」面板）导航到指定 http(s) 网址，加载发生在用户正在观看的同一个 webview 中，需用户授权联网。
localizedDescription.en-US: Navigates the visible in-app browser panel (Workbench Browser tab) to an absolute http(s) URL, in the same webview the user is watching.

url.description: The absolute http(s) URL to load in the visible browser.
